relics.title: Cracked glass screen
relics.text: HUMAN_REVIEW. A palm-sized pane, cracked, with no picture left in it. Azad writes: a window that forgot what it showed.

relics.title: Rusted gear
relics.text: HUMAN_REVIEW. Teeth worn smooth. It once turned something larger than a cart wheel. Azad does not know the machine.

relics.title: Strange metal tag
relics.text: HUMAN_REVIEW. Stamped marks, not letters he can read. No nation, no name. He keeps it in the diary.

relics.title: A coil of dull wire
relics.text: HUMAN_REVIEW. Soft metal in a spiral. It is not jewellery. It remembers being pulled through a wall.

relics.title: A little square key
relics.text: HUMAN_REVIEW. One key from a board of them. The mark on its face is worn away. Azad cannot say the word.

relics.title: A clay-cased cell
relics.text: HUMAN_REVIEW. A small sealed jar of another age. It is dead. The diary keeps the rubbing, not the spark.
